basic_info.description: Welcome home to this stunning modern residence in the popular Richmond District! Recently built, it was designed to meet the demands of modern life, with plenty of flexible spaces to work, entertain & relax. A centralized atrium window wall anchors this 4-level home and lets in abundant light. Multi-panel sliding glass doors open to decks on each floor to inspire indoor/outdoor living. The functional & flexible floor plan is open & airy & includes a main level of stylish living, dining & kitchen space, including a wet bar, den or bedroom, and 1 & 1/2 baths. The ground level is a legal second unit that expands family living use potential, with a second kitchen, living area, second laundry area, spacious bedroom, & full bath, as well as a one-car garage w/ extra storage & interior access. The 3rd level includes a beautiful primary suite w/ private deck, two additional bedrooms & a full bath. Crowning it all is a 4th level w/ sun-drenched pent room w/access to an East deck w/ dramatic downtown and GGB views, and West deck w/ outdoor BBQ kitchen and ocean views. A landscaped rear yard completes the drama of this curated residence. Incredible location near the newly-revitalized Balboa corridor, Lands End trailhead & just blocks from China Beach and Golden Gate Park. Walk Score: 93
